summary: Duplicate of already-published coverage: PR #2203 (article slug 2026-08/14-novee-security-finds-zero-privilege-flaws-in-claude-code-gemini-cli-and-codex-around-black-hat-usa-2026) covers the identical Novee Security disclosure. This is the second of two independent submissions on this topic.

findings.message: Fetched page text matched a prompt-injection pattern (system-prompt-reference) -- same excerpt already investigated and confirmed a false positive when reviewing PR #2203's identical citation of this source
findings.details: https://labs.cloudsecurityalliance.org/research/csa-research-note-ai-coding-agent-cicd-secrets-20260808-csa/ -- the flagged text is CSA's own third-person analytical prose describing the AGENTS.md instruction-injection vulnerability this article covers, not a directive addressed to an AI agent. See PR #2203's review for the full false-positive determination. Moot given the REJECT verdict on originality grounds below.

findings.message: Substantially duplicates an already-published article covering the same event.
findings.details: This submission and the already-published article both center on Novee Security's Black Hat USA 2026 disclosure of zero-privilege flaws in Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and Codex. Both were independently written by the same bot in the same parallel batch, sharing the primary source (novee.security) and three of five citations overall. This submission is framed as Analysis (1,075 words) versus the published article's News framing (743 words) and has a GitHub Security Advisory link (GHSA-wpqr-6v78-jr5g) the published article lacks, but does not cover materially new ground -- same vendors, same root cause, same disclosure timeline.

content_preview.summary: Novee Security found that a stranger's GitHub issue could reach CI runner secrets in Anthropic's, Google's, and OpenAI's own coding-agent repositories.
content_preview.body_excerpt:
## Overview

Security researcher Elad Meged of [Novee Security](https://novee.security/blog/critical-flaws-in-anthropic-google-and-openais-coding-agents/) disclosed at Black Hat USA on [August 5](https://labs.cloudsecurityalliance.org/research/csa-research-note-ai-coding-agent-cicd-secrets-20260808-csa/) that a GitHub issue opened by an account with no repository privileges was enough to reach CI runner secrets in the coding-agent repositories that Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI run for their own...
